topic: Can xenotransplantation solve the shortage of donor organs?
mode: Simulated current four-agent workflow with evidence-constrained artifacts; design and writing only.
final_conclusion: Xenotransplantation has meaningful short-term human feasibility and longer preclinical durability signals and may become a conditional, indication-limited supplement to human donation. Current evidence does not demonstrate that it can independently solve donor-organ shortage. Any shortage-relief claim must also satisfy manufacturing, surveillance, regulatory, and equity/access conditions.

stages.output_summary: Bounded evidence map, evidence levels, four accepted research gaps, and an Idea handoff.
Evidence-constrained portfolio that selects a falsifiable, non-clinical deployment-readiness direction.
